- [LCRS.14.13] **Call-site control-plane modifiers vs service kwargs.** The
  **honored general-call** modifier set is `{cooldown, as}` (kwarg-form) plus
  the `nocooldown` flag — these ride any call/response service without being
  declared kwargs. `retain:` is a reserved modifier **name** everywhere (never a
  bindable service kwarg ([LLEX.9.5])) and is **honored on no call** in this
  edition: the hydration endpoints that require it are deferred
  ([LHYD.6.2.2]), and on every call it is **reject-until-wired**
  (`DS_VALIDATE_RETAIN_UNWIRED`, [LCRS.6.3.3]), never silently accepted. On `emit`, `retain:` is a
  distinct action-modifier — the per-emit TTL override ([LDTL.4.1]); on
  `publish` it is refused ([LTIE.4.9]).
  Disambiguation is by action and protected service name, not by a declared
  kwarg.
